heroSourceLine: Official SPS 2025–26 student calendar and later district updates
heroSummary: SPS holds K–12 Launch Conferences August 28–29 before grades 1–12 begin September 2, 2025. Kindergarten starts through an A/B rotation, preschool programs begin later in September, and grades K–11 finish with a three-hour half day on June 16, 2026.
calendarNotes: Launch Conferences occur August 28–29 before ordinary classes, so families should treat them as an opening phase rather than the first full school days. Grades 1–12 begin September 2, while kindergarten uses an A/B rotation on September 3–4 before all kindergarten students attend September 9. PreK also begins September 9, and AM/PM and CIP preschool begin September 16, so preschool families need a program-specific date. Most instructional Mondays use a one-hour late start for collaboration, but holidays and no-school dates interrupt the pattern. PLID dates and the semester break day are full non-student days, while January 15–16 combine elementary progress conferences with an elementary non-student date. The three weather make-up reserves remained non-student days because SPS's final update kept June 16 as the K–11 last day. That later update also changed some preschool endings from the older PDF and confirmed a three-hour final day with breakfast but no lunch for grades K–11.

customSections.label: Late-Start Mondays, Weather Reserves, and Source Updates
customSections.content: The PDF shades Sep 8, 15, 22, 29; Oct 6, 13, 20, 27; Nov 3, 10, 17, 24; Dec 1, 8, 15; Jan 5, 12, 26; Feb 2, 9, 23; Mar 2, 9, 16, 23, 30; Apr 13, 20, 27; May 4, 11, 18; and Jun 1, 8, 15 as Late Start/Collaboration Mondays. February 17, March 13, and May 22 stayed non-student reserve days. The older PDF printed June 12 as the PreK last day, but SPS's June 10 update moved PreK, SSP, and CIP completion to June 11 while retaining June 10 for AM/PM Preschool.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Spokane Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 started Tuesday, September 2, 2025. Kindergarten used A/B groups September 3–4 and first attended together September 9.

calendarFaqs.q: What were SPS Launch Conferences in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Launch Conferences were August 28–29 for K–12 families. They occurred before ordinary classes and provided time to meet teachers or advisors and complete back-to-school preparation.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Spokane preschool programs start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: PreK began September 9. AM/PM and CIP preschool began September 16, so families needed to follow the date for their specific program.

calendarFaqs.q: Were the SPS weather make-up dates used in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: No. February 17, March 13, and May 22 remained non-student days, and the district's final update kept June 16 as the K–11 last day.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Spokane Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran April 6–10, 2026. Students returned Monday, April 13 on the late-start collaboration schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: What happened on the SPS last day in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades K–11 finished Tuesday, June 16 on a three-hour school day. Breakfast was served, lunch was not served, and buses used an adapted dismissal schedule.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, against the complete official student calendar, the SPS first-day guide, and the later end-of-year update; the supplied Board Meeting Calendar was excluded as the wrong document type.
sourceReviewDetails: The originally supplied PDF is visibly titled 2025–2026 Board Meeting Calendar and cannot support student calendar claims.
The replacement student PDF was located through an official SPS school page, rendered, and checked against its legend for late starts, holidays, conferences, staff days, and weather reserves.
The first-day article adds school-hour context and explains kindergarten A/B grouping and preschool program differences.
The June 10 district update supersedes the older PDF for preschool endings and confirms the K–11 three-hour last-day schedule, meal service, and transportation adjustment.
The final June 16 end date confirms that the three weather reserve dates were not activated.
